metadata.title: Healthy & Happy | A calmer way forward
metadata.description: A bilingual wellness foundation for Myanmar and beyond.

home.heroTitle: Build a healthier rhythm, one small choice at a time.
home.heroDescription: This sample page shows the foundation for a thoughtful wellness experience: clear guidance, calm interactions, and language that feels at home.
home.sectionTitle: A small system with room to breathe.
home.sectionDescription: Everything on this page is intentionally simple to inspect and extend. The UI primitives stay local, the copy stays portable, and motion stays respectful.
home.wellnessDescription: Design future wellness content around moments people can actually return to.
home.componentDescription: This card, badge, and button are shadcn/ui source components living in your project. You can style them without waiting on a hosted design system.
home.guideDescription: Run the command from your project root. The CLI adds an editable component to components/ui, so your product owns the code.
home.footerNote: Unicode-ready by design. Built for a healthier, happier web.
